milestones.title: Sketch the idea and rough plan

devlogs.text: We started sketching the frame and working out how to fit a one-metre build volume into it. There's still plenty to solve.
The README draft is up and the GitHub repo is public. We're still checking prices and changing the parts list.
We have a few tool-mount sketches. Now we're working out which one will be easiest to build and change over.
